verdict.rationale: Evidence shows llama.cpp ships a `llama serve` HTTP server component (gh-2, gh-18) that the built-in web UI talks to (gh-3), implying a programmatic API exists, but the pack contains no explicit documentation of API endpoints, request/response formats, or OpenAI-compatibility claims that an AI-native user could rely on. Missing for 10: explicit API reference/docs, examples of programmatic clients driving the server, and any third-party corroboration of API usage.
